items.why: Ledger #29: route 10 walked through 「战斗中无法使用」 (2026.10.12-11.25.16.239 inside its window of MaaEnd-06-58-38) and gathered nothing, so the per-route retry re-runs it before power-off (before the fix: 「全部路线走通，没有要补的」). The sim does not model MaaEnd's MXU API, so the retry gets no verdict and goes to the group; this entry proves the retry was started for the blocked route. On the machine a route the retry gathers is daily report only, one it still misses goes to the group.

The retry's verdict comes from MaaEnd (MXU's API and maafw.log node lines), which the sim does not model: here MXU never answers, so the retry has no verdict and goes to the group. On the machine a route the retry gathers is daily report only, one it still misses goes to the group.
